buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bid will be evaluated as per SBD ( standard Bid documents), which is uploaded in any other documents as per the specific requirements of bid as per Additional Qualification/Data Required. 2. Tenderer will submit EMD @ 2 % of the estimated bid value in rounds of ten as mentioned in the bid doc ument or submit proper exemption documents. 3. The tenderers must give an undertaking on their letterhead duly signed and stamped, mentioning the n ame and designation of the signing authority, that they will not claim any extra amount from Indian Railwa y over and above the contract value, during or after the contract period; otherwise, their offer will be sum marily rejected. 4. The tenderer shall provide a financial breakup of the minimum staff as specified in the tender document , based on the latest minimum wage rates, including ESI and EPF. The cost of consumables must not be qu oted as nil; otherwise, the offer shall be summarily rejected. 5. The tenderer shall submit all required documents in accordance with GCC Services 2018 (as amended), as specified in the Instructions to Bidders (Clauses 2.5.1.1, 2.5.2.2, 2.6.1.1, 2.6.2.1.2, and 2.6.2.1.3), along with their bid. Otherwise, the offer shall be summarily rejected.

6. The tenderers must submit valid updated copies of Udhyam registration certificate (MSME), ESI registrat ion certificate, EPF registration certificate, GST registration certificate and Pan card, duly signed and stamp ed by the bidder, otherwise their offer will be liable to be rejected. 7.An office/ Branch office must be located in the state of the consignee i.e. Delhi. Documentary evidence of address proof or a notarised, attested rent agreement to be submitted duly signed by the bidder, otherwis e, their offer will be summarily rejected. 8. Tenderer will accept sign and provide documents as required in all the under-noted documents i.e. (i) Sc ope of Work, (ii) Buyer Added specific SLA,( iii)Payment terms, (iv)Penalties (v) Any other documents as pe r th e specific requirements of Buyer -1 and 2 ”duly signed and stamped with date, otherwise their will be summarily rejected. 9.The bid shall be governed by the General Conditions of Contract (GCC) issued by the Railway Board and attached to this tender document. Bidders are advised to thoroughly read and understand the entire docu ment before submitting their offers. All bids must be submitted in strict compliance with the provisions an d requirements stipulated therein. Any offer that does not comply with these conditions shall be liable to b e summarily rejected. 10.If the firm fails to upload any required certificate/document along with the bid, the offer will be summar ily rejected. No Fresh documents will be entertained at the stage of representation. This will be governed by para 7.5.2 of the Manual of Procurement of Goods issued by the Ministry of Finance. . 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of FA AND CAO/C/K.GATE payable at Delhi . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C FA AND CAO/C/K.GATE,Delhi . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of FA AND CAO/C/K.GATE payable at Delhi . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of FA AND CAO/C/K.GATE payable at

Delhi . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of FA AND CAO/C/K.GATE, Delhi A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
